fun_fact: Tomorrow (Sept 27) is World Tourism Day. While many of us love to travel, it often comes with a huge footprint - the waste left behind, overconsumption of resources, pollution, unplanned development etc. So how can we all become more sustainable travellers? Start with [this Nat Geo guide](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/article/how-to-travel-better-a-beginners-guide-to-sustainable-travel-in-2023-and-beyond)!
